This plot is small, only a bit more than a quarter hectare, and it is not my maize plot — I am growing something else here mixed with another crop. I do not have schooling, so I do what I saw my father do and what my neighbors do. I keep my kraal manure for this plot because I own the land, and I save the little fertilizer I can get from the coupon for my maize. I will plant my own seed I kept from last harvest, and my wife and I will work it ourselves — no money to pay anyone.
